Google Compute Engine Machine Type n2-standard-2

General-purpose Google Compute Engine machine type n2-standard-2 with 2 vCPU and 8 GB memory. GCE machine type n2-standard-2 is certified for SAP applications on Google Cloud Platform. Available in 40 Google Cloud regions.
